population: Keep the original 52 randomly assigned pivot/background windows and all 466 eligible LoCoMo training questions. Sessions 9-12 form the additional donor block (12 windows, 88 questions, six dialogues). Reserve all 40 windows starting at session 13 or later (378 questions) for temporal extrapolation within the same histories. No later labels enter training. At registration record all raw score files already present. The full independent development and test requirements still apply.
evidence: For each assigned swap compare the two actual archived ordered writer paths. Only a question linked by annotated source turns at the randomized pivot and showing strict full-reference recovery can receive extra selection credit. Require identical state and two unchanged ordered slots. At the terminal pivot replay both full banks, reproduce both answers and try the original same-skill execution addition and bounded hidden retrieval tests. At the first pivot verify the fixed suffix skills and regenerated suffix writer and both reader controls, then try same-skill execution with suffix regeneration and one hidden-item retrieval. Use the existing rule-2 probes unchanged. Zero for missing controls, competing causes, ineligible or non-recovered questions; record the reason and the true raw F1 gap separately. Bind source and cache fingerprints. Do not silently drop a window.
learning: Use one span-level decision per paired window. Fit separate effects for root and terminal on earlier factorial sessions 5-8 plus the new 88-question donor block. For training on each held dialogue remove every row from that dialogue, including all early calibration observations. At either stage, each older factual window contributes two prefix/suffix conditions with weight 1/2 each; a randomized donor window contributes its one assigned condition with weight one. For root this estimates an effect averaged over the randomized fixed suffix, for terminal the actual earlier choice conditions the input state. The outcome target is the within-window mean of all eligible paired F1 differences plus signed rule-2 credits divided by the same number of questions. Use a balanced donor-history average and a shrinkage kernel on the pre-write controller state (positive cosine raised to eight); add one average donor-window equivalent of zero-effect prior. Convert the predicted advantage to an additive native logit shift at temperature 0.05, clipped to [-2,2]. Fit a raw-outcomes-only ablation, an early-only credit ablation and a stage-specific donor-rate logit control. Reuse ordered original branches and store question-weighted focal and two-step design-weighted HT F1 plus model usage. Require the original promotion gates on the untouched evaluation block, then independent development. Probabilities frozen after a raw score file exists for a window are not classified as strictly prospective.
